summary: Code review PASS. 'standalone' runner type correctly added across all 6 system layers: RunnerType union, two Zod schemas, GUI label+order constants, CSS token pairs (emerald, light+dark), and ledger-store runtime cast.

Fix-Forward 1: ledger-store.ts L524 hardcoded literal union cast replaced with `as RunnerType` import, eliminating the maintenance debt where future RunnerType expansions require a separate manual update to this cast.

Fix-Forward 2 (correction): synthesis-parser.ts WP-001 Fix-Forward introduced TS2532 because TypeScript types RegExpExecArray indices as string|undefined. Corrected to `match[1]!.trim()` (non-null assertion). tsc --noEmit clean; all 17 tests pass.
RUNNER_ORDER positioning verified: ['orchestrator', 'vscode', 'claude-code', 'standalone', 'unknown'] — standalone correctly before unknown.

comments.note: reviewer-applied-fix (WP-004): ledger-store.ts — added `import type { RunnerType } from '../utils/runner.js'` and replaced the hardcoded string literal union cast `as 'vscode' | 'claude-code' | 'orchestrator' | 'standalone' | 'unknown'` with `as RunnerType`. Eliminates the drift risk flagged by the Developer: future RunnerType additions will now automatically apply to the cast. tsc --noEmit clean. Behavior unchanged.

reviewer-applied-fix (correction to WP-001 Fix-Forward): synthesis-parser.ts extractFirstBullet() — the initial Fix-Forward (WP-001 review) simplified `const text = match[1]; return text !== undefined ? text.trim() : null` to `return match[1].trim()` which triggered TS2532 (Object is possibly 'undefined') because TypeScript types RegExpExecArray indices as string|undefined. Corrected to `return match[1]!.trim()` (non-null assertion) which is semantically accurate — the `.+` regex guarantees a non-empty capture group when match is truthy. tsc --noEmit clean; all 17 synthesis-parser tests pass.

No blocking findings on WP-004 implementation. 'standalone' is consistently added across all 6 layers: RunnerType union (runner.ts), both Zod schemas (root-index.ts, project-meta.ts), GUI label map + order array (project-list.js), CSS token pairs light+dark + badge rule (styles.css), storage layer cast (ledger-store.ts). Emerald color is visually distinct from existing badge colors.
